## Summary

Describe the change and its user-visible or operational impact.

## Validation

List the checks run and any validation that could not be completed.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Required CodeQL, dependency-review, build, and test checks pass.
- [ ] I validated applicable Copilot review findings before merging.
- [ ] I ran or requested the dedicated Copilot security review for security-sensitive changes and validated
      applicable findings.

The Copilot reviews are advisory and do not replace required checks or human validation.
